title: Lead I - Software Engineering
description:
**Role description**  


Who We Are

At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our clients to co\-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees across 30\+ countries, we build for boundless impact, touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at **www.ust.com**.


Summary

UST is seeking a highly skilled **Senior****Java****Developer** with expertise in **Enterprise****Marketing****Management****(EMM),****SSIS,****Java****Microservices,****and****Azure\-based****enterprise****application****development**. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in backend development, enterprise application customization, integration, and data transformation solutions.


The Opportunity
**Job****Title:** Senior Java Developer – EMM \& SSIS  

**Location:** Trivandrum / Hybrid  

**Experience:** 6\+ Years


Mandatory Skills
* Java (Java 8\+)
* Spring Boot
* Microservices Architecture
* Enterprise Marketing Management (EMM) Customization
* REST APIs
* SSIS (SQL Server Integration Services)
* SQL Server
* Enterprise Application Integration
* Azure Cloud
* CI/CD Practices
* JSON \& XML
* Object\-Oriented Design (OOD)

Job Responsibilities

As a **Senior****Java****Developer**, you will:


* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise\-grade backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.
* Customize, configure, and extend Enterprise Marketing Management (EMM) platforms based on business requirements.
* Analyze existing enterprise application architectures and implement enhancements without disrupting current functionality.
* Design and develop scalable RESTful APIs and backend services supporting enterprise workflows.
* Integrate EMM platforms with internal systems and third\-party applications.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand functional requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Develop microservices\-based applications adhering to enterprise architecture standards.
* Participate in technical design reviews, code reviews, and application modernization initiatives.
* Support and troubleshoot production applications, integrations, and enterprise workflows.
* Develop and maintain SSIS packages for ETL and enterprise data integration processes.
* Perform data transformation, mapping, validation, and error\-handling activities across multiple systems.
* Work closely with DevOps teams to implement CI/CD deployment pipelines.
* Support cloud\-native deployments and modernization initiatives using Azure services.
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to technical best practices across the team.
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, retrospectives, and backlog refinement sessions.

Required Technical Skills
### **Core****Java****Development**


* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in Java backend development.
* Strong expertise in Java 8 or higher.
* Extensive experience with Spring Boot and enterprise backend application development.
* Strong understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming, Design Patterns, and SOLID principles.
* Experience designing scalable microservices architectures.
* Expertise in REST API development and integration.

### **EMM****\&****Enterprise****Application****Customization**


* Hands\-on experience working with Enterprise Marketing Management (EMM) platforms.
* Experience customizing, configuring, and extending enterprise applications.
* Ability to understand existing enterprise ecosystems and develop enhancements efficiently.
* Experience implementing business workflows and process automation.
* Strong troubleshooting skills for enterprise applications and integrations.

### **Integration****\&****Middleware**


* Strong experience with JSON, XML, API integrations, and enterprise communication protocols.
* Experience integrating enterprise applications with third\-party platforms and internal systems.
* Knowledge of service\-oriented and event\-driven architectures.

### **SSIS****\&****Data****Integration**


* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
* Experience developing and maintaining ETL processes.
* Strong understanding of data extraction, transformation, and loading methodologies.
* Experience in database\-driven integrations and SQL Server optimization.
* Ability to troubleshoot, optimize, and enhance existing SSIS packages and jobs.

### **Database****Technologies**


* Strong knowledge of SQL Server and relational databases.
* Expertise in database design, query optimization, and performance tuning.
* Experience handling large\-volume enterprise data integrations.

### **Cloud****\&****DevOps**


* Experience with Microsoft Azure or equivalent cloud platforms.
* Knowledge of cloud\-native backend development and deployment.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices.
* Experience supporting enterprise application deployments in cloud environments.

Preferred / Optional Skills
### **Cloud****Modernization**


* Experience with Azure App Services.
* Azure Functions.
* Azure SQL Database.
* Azure Service Bus.
* Cloud migration and modernization projects.

### **Containerization****\&****DevOps**


* Experience with Docker.
* Kubernetes deployment and orchestration.
* Infrastructure automation and containerized application deployment.

### **AI****\&****Advanced****Integrations**


* Exposure to AI/GenAI\-enabled enterprise solutions.
* Experience integrating backend applications with AI Services and APIs.
* Understanding of AI\-driven workflow enhancements and intelligent automation.

### **Domain****Experience**


* Enterprise Marketing platforms and campaign management solutions.
* Customer engagement and marketing automation ecosystems.
* Legacy application modernization initiatives.
* Large\-scale enterprise transformation programs.

### **Methodologies**


* Agile / Scrum delivery experience.
* Production support and application enhancement activities.
* Cross\-functional collaboration within distributed teams.

What We Believe

We're proud to embrace the same values that have shaped UST since the beginning. Since day one, we've been building enduring relationships and a culture of integrity. Today, those same values inspire us to encourage innovation, champion diversity and inclusion, and place people at the center of everything we do.


### **Humility**



We will listen, learn, be empathetic, and help selflessly in our interactions with everyone.


### **Humanity**



Through business, we will better the lives of those less fortunate than ourselves.


### **Integrity**



We honour our commitments and act with responsibility in all our relationships.


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

UST is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences, such as age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, religion, or sexual orientation.



All employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by law.



UST reserves the right to periodically redefine roles and responsibilities based on organizational requirements and employee performance.


* Support and promote UST values.
* Comply with all company policies and procedures.

Skills
### **Primary****Skills**


* Java
* Spring Boot
* Microservices
* EMM Customization
* SSIS
* SQL Server
* Azure
* REST APIs


  

**Skills**  

Microservices, Java, CI/CD, Spring Boot

 **About UST**  

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future\-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Minimum Required Experience : 8 years
Full Time
**Skills**
----------


Pre Sales
Client Engagement
**Description**
---------------


**Energy \& Utilities \- Subject Matter Expert**


*Pre\-Sales support \& Act as an SME for Energy domain practice.*


**Function**


Pre\-Sales / Practice \- Energy


**Reports to**


DU head\-Energy, with a close working line into the Delivery Manager, Solutions Architects, Vice President \- Practice


**Employment type**


Full\-time/ Consultant


**Location**


Trivandrum


**Travel**


On\-Demand domestic and international travel


**Team**


NeST Digital – Product Engineering Service

  

**The Role**
============


We're hiring an Energy \& Utilities Subject Matter Expert to be the technical credibility behind every business client conversation. This is a client\-facing role, not a back\-office analyst position: you will sit across the table from plant owners, CFOs, grid operations managers, and hospital facilities directors, and you need to be able to look at their actual energy\-relevant verticals: industrial manufacturing (compressed air, motors, humidification, demand charges), grid and water utilities, and building/healthcare energy (HVAC, generators, critical power).


**Key Responsibilities**
========================


**Pre\-sales \& client engagement**
-----------------------------------


* Lead the technical/domain conversation in prospect meetings, pilot kickoffs, and proof\-of\-value engagements.
* Represent NeST Digital in client workshops and business reviews, presenting findings directly to customers and leadership.
* Partner with Sales and Solutions Architecture to scope pilot assets, define baseline measurement points, etc.
* Build and maintain vertical\-specific business use cases, ROI calculators, and reference case studies used by the sales and marketing team.
* Stay current on the regulatory drivers that create urgency for prospects — BRSR, EU CBAM, India's PAT scheme, ISO 50001, Qatar National Vision 2030, Saudi Vision 2030 — and translate them into commercial conversation, not just compliance trivia.

**Product \& delivery support**
-------------------------------


* Work with the ML/AI engine team to ground anomaly thresholds and energy\-normalisation logic in real engineering behaviour, not just statistical baselines.
* Sanity\-check on every energy related proposal, offerings from the DU/BU.
* Be up\-to\-date on the innovation, Guide and prepare critical offerings, service for Energy customer and help to build strong skill set inside the organization.

**Basic Qualifications**
========================


* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Energy, or Industrial Engineering.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in industrial energy audits, energy management, or utility\-side efficiency programmes.
* Working knowledge of compressed\-air systems, HVAC, motor efficiency, demand\-side management, and electricity tariff structures.
* A track record of presenting technical findings to leadership, technical(Hardware/Software ) \& non\-technical stakeholders.
* Multi industry experience in Energy \& utilities.

**Nice to Have**
================


* Certified Energy Auditor (BEE, India) or Certified Energy Manager (AEE).
* Familiarity with ISO 50001 energy management systems.
* Ideally experienced on multi asset at an IoT, SCADA, BESS, BMS, or energy\-tech vendor.
* Exposure to Gulf utility or infrastructure programmes.
* Familiarity with ESG/carbon reporting frameworks (BRSR, GHG Protocol, CBAM).
* Adherence to international and Indian standards
  

	+ IEC 61850/61970/61968 for communication
	+ IEEE 1547 for distributed resource interconnection
	+ IEC 62443 \& ISO 27001 for cybersecurity
	+ CEA/CERC/MNRE regulations for grid compliance

Full Time
**Skills**

C\#.Net
Winforms
WPF
**Description**
---------------


**Role Overview**


At NeST Digital, we foster a dynamic environment where professionals can learn, grow, and innovate. We're currently seeking talented **C\#, .NET developers with Winforms skills** to join programs driven by our **S**mart **T**echnology **C**enter in Trivandrum \- to design and develop mission critical applications for the industrial manufacturing domain. The candidate will have complete, end\-to\-end ownership of the application, spanning the entire life\-cycle. The ideal candidate is expected to have a solid experience in the .NET technology stack and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy robust applications for industrial use.


**Responsibilities****:**


* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code in C\#, Winforms
* Translate complex industrial requirements into innovative software solutions.
* Develop and integrate APIs, third\-party libraries, and hardware interfaces.
* Conduct unit testing, debug applications, and resolve performance bottlenecks.
* Prepare comprehensive technical documentation for future reference.
* Ensure application performance, uptime and scale, and maintain high standards for code quality
* Engage with UX designers and front\-end engineers, collaborate with back\-end systems and engineers to create reliable APIs
* Work with agile development methodologies, adhering to best practices

**Experience****:**

* At least **4\-8 yrs** years of Industry experience in building Windows desktop applications
* Experience in **designing and integrating third party systems** through interfaces and APIs
  

**Technical skills****:**


* Strong proficiency in **C\# and the .NET** framework, **Winforms**
* Hands\-on experience with Windows application development.
* Solid understanding of object\-oriented programming (OOP) principles.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills.
* Hands\-on experience in integration of front\-end and back\-end components to meet system requirements
* Working knowledge of common design patters and application architectures
* Excellent debugging and optimization skills
* Knowledge in unit/integration testing
  

**Qualifications:**

* MCA/Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in computer science, information technology, or engineering
* Interest in learning new tools, languages, workflows, and philosophies
* Professional certifications
